formationsPage.title: Our training programs
formationsPage.subtitle: Harvest Center offers language, professional, and educational programs designed to build useful, lasting, and recognized skills in both local and international environments.
formationsPage.programsSubtitle: Our offers cover language learning, professional capacity building, academic support, leadership, culture, and future readiness.

international.text: An offer designed to prepare learners for communication, mobility, and excellence in a global environment.

results.text: Each program is designed around clear objectives, observable skills, and concrete progress.

learner.text: We prioritize interaction, practice, personalized follow-up, and confidence building.

languages.description: Language training pathways designed to strengthen speaking, comprehension, professional ease, and international openness.

audiences.3: Applicants for scholarships, jobs, and mobility opportunities

outcomes.1: Communicate better in academic and professional contexts
outcomes.2: Build confidence in speaking and writing

capacity.title: Professional Capacity Building
capacity.description: Practical training programs to develop essential skills for professional, institutional, and entrepreneurial environments.

highlights.2: Presentation techniques, public speaking, and professional posture

outcomes.3: Increase impact in projects and teams

coaching.title: Academic Coaching and Personalized Support
coaching.description: Targeted support to help each learner progress according to their level, pace, and personal or professional goals.

audiences.1: Learners facing challenges or moving up a level
audiences.2: Candidates preparing for exams or competitions

outcomes.3: Support tailored to each learner’s profile

education.title: Educational Programs, Clubs, and Leadership
education.description: Dynamic learning spaces designed to develop intellectual curiosity, critical thinking, leadership, and citizenship.

highlights.2: Leadership, public speaking, and citizenship workshops

outcomes.3: Train learners who are more open, responsible, and confident

outcomes.1: Perform better in assessments and exams
outcomes.3: Obtain evidence of skills for personal and professional projects
